query:
SELECT u.id as "id!: SbUserId", u.email_verified,
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM user_restrictions r
                    WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.kind = 'map_publishing'::restriction_kind
                        AND r.start_time <= now() AND r.end_time > now()
                ) as "restricted!"
            FROM users u
            WHERE u.id = ANY($1)
